text:
Rae: Morning quick scan — queue at 34 (up 4 from yesterday). Two active P2s: embeddings latency regression and a Dedicated deploy failure. I updated macros: /macro-retry now includes cluster ID, /macro-escalate has SRE on-call template. I'll OOO at 11:30 PST, handing off to Tom. :wave:
Sasha: @Rae looking into embeddings spike now. Saw a pattern around 03:02UTC — appears tied to a new quantization flag. :eyes: Adding note to ticket and updating macro suggestions.
Tom: taking the deploy P2 while you're OOO. Which cluster is failing?
ops-bot: Deploy failure detected on dedicated-prod/gpu-pool-2 host gpu-07. Error: "CUDA out of memory". Rolling back to previous revision.
Rae: thanks @ops-bot. Tom — try redeploy with warmup and reduced batch size. Example command: ```redwood deploy --env dedicated-prod --warmup 2 --batch-size 8``` Also consider toggling quantization profile q3 -> q2 for this model.
Tom: copying the command. I'll attempt a redeploy in ~5m.
Ivy: FYI I triaged a user report about truncated streaming output, created ticket #SR-12847. Repro steps attached in the ticket. Suggest adding streaming macro /macro-stream-check which reminds to check prefix caching and client-side read loop.
Sasha: quick update — rolling back the q4 quantization on the embeddings model reduced 99p latency by ~120ms in my local perf run. Pushing patch to prod deploy plan.
Rae: perfect. When you push the plan, include these entries in the macro library: - "Embeddings: quantization rollback checklist" and - "Streaming: prefix cache validation" so support can apply quickly.
Sasha: will add both macros now. Content snippet for embed rollback macro: ```Steps:\n1) Switch model quant profile to q2\n2) Restart model pool with --drain\n3) Monitor 99p via /metrics/embed_latency\n4) If > baseline, escalate to SRE```
Tom: redeploy started. If redeploy fails again I'll escalate using /macro-escalate.
ops-bot: Redeploy job 7721 status: started on gpu-03; monitoring logs.
Sasha: pasted relevant log snippet from the embed service: ```2026-03-17T08:14:21Z ERROR kernel_selector: selection failed for cuda-sm80 - fallback to cpu``` — that explains the latency spike.
Rae: OK good catch. Sasha please pin that in the ticket and mark "possible kernel selection mismatch" in the macro.
Ivy: I can cover incoming DM escalation while Rae's OOO. Leaving a quick handoff note in the support board. :thumbsup:
Tom: redeploy completed with warmup flag, initial checks look green. 99p latency back to baseline. Closing the deploy P2 after 15m stable.
Rae: thanks everyone — leaving a brief post-incident note in the channel when I'm back online. If anything breaks ping @Sasha or escalate via /macro-escalate.
